hero.headline: Pure Gavran Desi Eggs
hero.subheadline: Naturally raised, rich in nutrition and collected fresh every single day. At ShaktiFarm we practise ethical, chemical-free farming so every egg carries the taste of pure heritage.

about.title: OUR STORY
about.headline: Ethically raised, naturally nourished
about.description_1: ShaktiFarm began with a simple belief - that the purest eggs come from the happiest hens. Our free-range Gavran birds roam open pastures, feed on a natural chemical-free diet and are cared for under strict hygiene standards.
about.description_2: Every egg is collected fresh daily, hand-graded and dispatched the same day, so your family receives nothing but authentic, wholesome nutrition. As a trusted manufacturer, supplier and exporter, quality is our promise.

product.description: Sourced from our free-range Gavran hens, these light-brown desi eggs deliver deeper flavour, firmer whites and golden nutrient-dense yolks - perfect for daily consumption, hotels, restaurants and bakeries.
